metadata.title: Congruence theorems for capillary hypersurfaces and a substatic Heintze--Karcher inequality
metadata.abstract: We prove congruence theorems for capillary hypersurfaces of Euclidean space supported on a hyperplane or on a sphere, extending a result of Ros for closed hypersurfaces. We also establish a Heintze--Karcher type inequality for capillary hypersurfaces in substatic manifolds.

analysis.workSummary: 建立以超平面或球面为支撑的 Euclidean 毛细超曲面全等定理，并证明次静态流形中的 Heintze–Karcher 型不等式。
analysis.breakthrough: 把闭超曲面结果推进到接触边界条件。
